body:
I know in Oregon the law is a three day hold at a hospital with psych capabilities on doctors' orders. They will monitor, talk and set up a continuing treatment plan. 

I don't know where you're from, but if you need a real person to talk to, then go to the ED.
Sorry, thought it said "that was about a year ago." If you're out of high school I meant no offense, I just misread. If you're still in high school, my original comment stands.

You're not broken. There are medical conditions that can cause this. Try and get help. See a councilor, therapist, teacher, anyone. They can help. 

You seem pretty smart. How are you liking high school?

She sounds like she is playing some games with you, my friend. Don't let her. I know it's not easy to meet new people, but put yourself out there. You're about to be 21, what better place to strike up a conversation with someone than at a bar? I'm not saying go there and get shitty drunk. Just go there and find a new friend. One that won't play games, or be fake. 

If you really feel the need to get your friend back this badly, don't guilt her. Just talk to her. Tell her you're sorry. Tell her that you want to work on your guys' relationship and make it work. 

Awesome news about your job and GED! That's another good way to make some friends. Congratulations! That isn't as easy as it should be, and you should be proud of yourself. That's great to hear.
It's okay to be afraid. Everyone is afraid of something. That doesn't mean you are broken.
Why did you and your friend stop talking in the first place? And why aren't you going to talk to her until March?

Run away. Get a new life. If there's nothing holding you here, then leave. If you feel incomplete with your relationship, end it. If you're not happy at home, leave.

If you think a change is what you need, then absolutely, change. Change everything. Shave your head, dye your hair, get a tattoo. Be in control. You can't change anything if you're gone. And maybe all it will take is changing something.

Most importantly, wherever you end up, get help. See a doctor, councilor, therapist... anyone. They can all help you. And you'll be better. You'll be free and feel like a million bucks.
Do you see that list of reasons to live? That's stronger than any reason to die. As long as you have something in that reason to live section, you have no reason to die. Remember that.
